date.as_written: tryaṅgābdasaṃmite śāke rādhe māsi bhṛgor dine

purpose: merit/dedication: anena lipikarmaṇā prīto 'stu śrīrāmeśaḥ (may Rāmeśa be pleased by this copying)
notes: The chronogram 'tryaṅgābda-saṃmite śāke' is incomplete or corrupt. As written, tri = 3 and aṅga = 6, read right to left as 63; 'abda' is probably just 'year', so the higher digits are missing. If 'abda' is a corruption of 'abdhi' (= 4), the reading would be 463, again with the thousands digit missing (e.g. 1463 if a 'bhū' was lost). None of these readings gives the catalogue's ŚS 1800, so the catalogue date may be the cataloguer's estimate or may come from elsewhere in the manuscript. ce_approx is left empty. The catalogue also names 'Dharaṇidhara' as a scribe, but he does not appear in the quoted colophon; he may be named elsewhere (e.g. in an earlier section colophon), so he is not included here. The text ends with the 4th (antardaśā) adhyāya, which appears to complete the work. 'Rāmeśa' is a deity in the dedication and is not counted as a person. 'Uḍudāyapradīpodyota' is a commentary on the Uḍudāyapradīpa (Laghupārāśarī).
